audit.whatIsWrong: Rows 2-6 (Kennen, Kennen, Ziggs, Kennen, Kennen) contradict the already-audited mirror, which settled Level 3 = Skill, Levels 4-5 = Ziggs, Level 6 = Kennen, First item = Skill, 2+ items = Ziggs.
audit.why: Level 6 is Kennen's one owned stage — Slicing Maelstrom is a flat 120s AoE stun at 550 range — while the late game belongs to Ziggs' siege and zone control, not to a single engage ult.
audit.corrected: Rows 2-6 flipped to the mirror's values as one atomic group, proposed as matched full/content pairs with ratings.

audit.whatIsWrong: Stage whys carried no cooldown numbers and put the level-6 edge on Ziggs.
audit.why: Lightning Rush 10s at rank 1 (6s at rank 5) and Slicing Maelstrom's flat 120s are the two clocks that decide when Ziggs may step up.
audit.corrected: phases[0], [2], [3], [4].why, breakdown.cooldowns and report[5] now carry those numbers.

audit.whatIsWrong: Four fields claim 'your Q out-ranges' him. Kennen's Thundering Shuriken is 950 range against Ziggs' 850 Q — the raw range advantage is his. Mark of the Storm's third-mark stun and Electrical Surge's on-hit application are also unstated.
audit.why: Same false range claim the mirror audit already killed on Kennen's page; a Ziggs player spacing at 'max range' is standing inside Shuriken range every time.
audit.corrected: Reframed to the real edge — Q returns every 6s at rank 1 and bounces past its cast range — in tldr, report[0], phases[0].why, whys[0] and early. Added the third-mark stun and the on-hit note.

audit.whatIsWrong: Electrical Surge applies on-hit and scales with attack speed; nothing on the page says armour reads this trade wrong.
audit.why: missingInteractions onhit-itemization rule for this pairing.
